final_netlist:
.subckt dut vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias
* ---- bias: sink IREF with diode-connected nfet ----
MB  ibias ibias vss vss nfet W=4 L=1
* ---- tail current source ----
M5  tail  ibias vss vss nfet W=24 L=1
* ---- input differential pair (vinn on diode side, vinp on output side) ----
M1  x   vinn tail vss nfet W=8 L=0.5
M2  y   vinp tail vss nfet W=8 L=0.5
* ---- PMOS current-mirror load ----
M3  x   x   vdd vdd pfet W=20 L=1
M4  y   x   vdd vdd pfet W=20 L=1
* ---- second stage: PMOS common source + NMOS sink ----
M6  vout y     vdd vdd pfet W=140 L=0.5
M8  vout ibias vss vss nfet W=120 L=1
* ---- Miller compensation with nulling resistor ----
Rc  y   cz  1000
Cc  cz  vout 3e-12
.ends dut
